title: USAF M-65 Field Jacket DCU 3 Color Desert Camo Medium Regular Air Combat Command
description:
US Air Force M-65 field coat in three color desert camouflage (DCU). The label reads Coat, Cold Weather, Field, Desert Camouflage Pattern, size Medium Regular, made by Golden Mfg. Co., Inc. It carries a U.S. Air Force tape, a name tape and an Air Combat Command patch.

Pre-owned. Please review all photos for condition.

Measured flat: chest 22 inches pit to pit, length 31 inches, shoulders 19 inches, sleeves 26 inches.
